title: one-change changelog entry (omnimarket#3549)
prompt:
Summarize the merged change below in at most two sentences for a changelog: what changed, then why. Name the pull request number exactly as written (#NNNN). Use only facts stated in the change text. Also name the ticket OMN-20712.

--- change 1 (repo omnimarket, pull request #3549) ---
feat(OMN-20712): host lab-fill selection and lab disk hygiene nodes with deployment overlays (#3549)
* feat(OMN-20712): host lab-fill selection and lab disk hygiene nodes with deployment overlays

Adds src/omnimarket/nodes/node_lab_fill_selection_compute (operations select_lab_fill_work and mark_approved_work_done) and src/omnimarket/nodes/node_lab_disk_hygiene_effect (operation run_lab_disk_hygiene), copied from the operator tooling repository in canonical shape (contract, metadata, handlers, models).
Selection logic and hygiene logic are unchanged; only the deployment facts moved out.
Lab-fill selection: the repository roles (companion, not-work, document repositories) were module constants; they are now a required typed field, ModelLabFillDeployment, validated from the overlay mapping by ModelLabFillDeployment.from_overlay.
The compute node does no environment or file access (node-purity hook).
Disk hygiene: the default census path is gone; the census comes from the request or from the deployment overlay key census_path, resolved from OMNIMARKET_LAB_DISK_HYGIENE_OVERLAY, else <root>/node_lab_disk_hygiene_effect/overlay.yaml for each root in ONEX_SKILL_OVERLAY_ROOTS.
With no census anywhere, no container is removed and the prunes still run.
The module docstring no longer describes a specific host.
Both nodes are called in process: lifecycle experimental, no bus topics, no onex.nodes entry point in pyproject.toml.
tests/test_market_node_runtime_dogfood.py lists them in EXPECT

Respond with the answer only. Do not show your reasoning, do not narrate your steps, and do not preface the answer with anything.
